text:
Priya Shah: Quick sync on OpalBay onboarding health  p95 drifting to ~410ms over the past 72h, token cost ~+20% vs forecast. Renewal intro meeting in ~5w. Want a low-risk ops win to show measurable improvement. Idea: short canary of int8 for long-context chat + route doc/embedding lookups to a compact model. Thoughts?
Nadia Park: That seems reasonable. Do we have a breakdown by user tier or endpoint? Might prefer routing only non-SLA traffic to compact.
Priya Shah: Mostly /chat/generate for active users; a sizeable portion includes long system prompts and doc fetches before generation. I pulled a route-level heatmap.
Samir Gupta: For long-context workloads int8 reduces memory bandwidth and often cuts p95. Quality risk is the main concern keep the eval suite tight. Also suggest a tiny prefix-based rule: if request.kv_cache_length > 1024 then route to quantized path.
Jorge Rivera: From the CSM side they'd accept a staged experiment with clear rollback. They also asked we avoid changing responses for billing-sensitive flows.
Priya Shah: Good call. Let's design the experiment: 5% traffic to int8 canary for chat, and route any request tagged `doc_search` or with embeddings to `redwood-compact-s` (completion-only). Add quality gates and automatic rollback.
Samir Gupta: Rollout snippet for SREs (handy for their infra team): ```json
{
  "rules": [
    {"endpoint": "/chat/generate", "mode": "canary", "percent": 5, "model": "opal-int8-q2"},
    {"endpoint": "/chat/generate", "mode": "route", "match": {"meta.tags": ["doc_search", "embedding"]}, "model": "redwood-compact-s"}
  ]
}
```
Nadia Park: ops-bot, can you queue a perf compare of opal-int8-q2 vs opal-fp16 baseline on 450 anonymized traces from their onboarding traffic? Include p50/p95/p99 and token-cost delta.
ops-bot: Scheduled perf-smoke job #40321 for OpalBay. Samples: 450. ETA ~35m. I will publish results here when done.
Samir Gupta: Quality gate: run `eval-suite run --cust opalbay --suite onboarding-critical --min 0.965`  fail > rollback. Also capture hallucination rate and exact-match on a target set.
Priya Shah: Include instructions to disable canary quickly if customers see semantic changes: endpoint flip + revoke model alias (we'll document commands). Jorge, we'll send the SRE playbook and ask for a 2-hour low-traffic window.
Jorge Rivera: I'll coordinate with their infra team and target a midnight window (customer local timezone) next week. They asked for a pre-brief doc with expected numbers to share internally.
ops-bot: perf-smoke #40321 complete  summary: int8 p95 -13%, p99 -6%, token cost per request -11.5%. Eval-suite: avg quality 96.6% on onboarding-critical. Full logs: https://ci.redwood/smoke/40321
Nadia Park: Those numbers look solid. Proposed ramp: 24h @5% -> 24h @25% -> 48h @50%, with auto-rollback if eval-suite <96% or p99 increases.
Samir Gupta: I'll prepare a rollback playbook and the exact commands to flip routing and revoke aliases. Also add a troubleshooting checklist (latency spikes, increased error rates, divergence metrics).
Priya Shah: Action items: Priya -> send SRE playbook + coordinate window; Jorge -> confirm customer window and internal pre-brief; Samir -> rollback/playbook + runbook; Nadia -> update renewal slides with before/after numbers and expected cost savings.
Jorge Rivera: I'll ask for a short quote from OpalBay ops after the 25% step for the renewal deck.
Priya Shah: Thanks team. We'll reconvene after the 25% ramp and capture concrete numbers for renewal. Posting enablement doc link once it's live. :sparkles:
